```{r}
#| label: fig-bilirubin
#| fig-cap: "Bilirubin"

plotdata <- bind_rows(escdata %>% mutate(ef_cat = "Overall"), escdata %>% arrange(ef_cat)) %>%
  mutate(
    ef_cat = fct_inorder(ef_cat),
    ef_catnum = as.numeric(ef_cat)
  )

bardata <- plotdata %>%
  group_by(ef_catnum, ef_cat) %>%
  count(Bili_mgdL_cat) %>%
  mutate(
    p = n / sum(n) * 10,
    pprint = paste0(fn(p * 10, 0), "%")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Bili_mgdL_cat == "Yes")

p <- ggplot(data = bardata, aes(x = ef_catnum + 0.1, p, fill = ef_cat)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2), stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = global_cols[1:4]) +
  geom_boxplot(data = plotdata, aes(x = ef_catnum - 0.1, Bili_mgdL, fill = ef_cat), width = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(trans = ~ . * 10, name = "Elevated bilirubin (%)"), limits = c(0, 5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = levels(plotdata %>% pull(ef_cat)), breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 4)) +
  geom_text(
    data = bardata,
    aes(x = ef_catnum + 0.1, label = pprint),
    nudge_y = 10 * 0.03,
    size = 5.5,
    color = rep(global_cols[1:4]),
    fontface = "bold",
    check_overlap = F
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "lightgrey",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      linetype = 2
    ),
    text = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(y = "Bilirubin (mg/dL)")

if (output) {
  create_pptx(p)
}
p
```
